pretreatments.description: Air-drying of corn stover to a moisture content less than 10%.
Grinding of air-dried corn stover to pass through a 5 mm sieve.
Solid-state alkaline pretreatment with NaOH (0.25, 0.625, 1.25, and 1.85 M) soaking for 24 hours at ambient temperature (20 ± 0.5 °C) in sealed zipper plastic bags.
Solid-state anaerobic digestion of pretreated corn stover with effluent of liquid AD as inoculum and nitrogen source at 37 °C for 40 days.
Simultaneous alkaline treatment and SS-AD with NaOH (0.25, 0.625, and 1.25 M) and effluent.
